name: dev
description: Plan-driven software development: explore and converge, write an implementation plan, then execute and review it.
shortDescription: Explore, plan, execute, and review software changes.
longDescription: Dev packages three plan-driven development skills: dev-explore maps the codebase and converges on a direction, dev-write-plan turns that direction into an outcome contract, and dev-execute-plan implements the plan and verifies the result.
defaultPrompt: Use dev-explore to understand this codebase and converge on an approach.
Use dev-write-plan to turn this requirement into an implementation plan.
Use dev-execute-plan to implement and review the next TODO plan.
